profile.title: Me
profile.sign_out_confirm_body: Are you sure? Your local data stays on the device.
profile.rates_single: You only use one currency: no rates are requested
profile.crop_hint: Drag to move, pinch to zoom.
profile.photo_error_permission: The app has no permission to see your photos. Turn it on in your phone settings.
profile.photo_error_unavailable: The installed version of the app can't process images yet. It needs to be reinstalled from a new build.
profile.photo_error_failed: That image couldn't be processed. Try another one.

auth.welcome_subtitle: No server. No cloud. P2P sync only between group members.
auth.terms_suffix: Your data travels encrypted and the key is yours alone.
auth.privacy_no_server_body: Your expenses travel encrypted. The mailbox stores envelopes it has no way to open, and the key never leaves your devices.
auth.privacy_p2p_body: Over the internet, or between two phones scanning a QR — that path touches no server at all.
auth.privacy_members_body: Each group encrypts its data with a key shared when inviting.
auth.privacy_tracking_body: No third-party analytics. No data selling.
auth.error_google: Couldn't sign in with Google. Try again.
auth.error_apple: Couldn't sign in with Apple. Try again.
auth.link_body: You already use SplitP2P with {{account}}. Do you want to sign in to that account and merge your data?

groups.title: Groups
groups.empty_body: Create a group to split expenses with friends.
groups.no_contacts: You do not have saved contacts yet.
groups.select_hint: Select at least one contact to create the group.
groups.empty_archived_body: Swipe a group left to take it off the main list. Nothing is deleted: its expenses and balances stay intact.
groups.deletion_consensus_hint: Deleting someone else's expense has to be requested. Others have 72h to object. Whoever added it can delete it right away.
groups.deletion_open_hint: Anyone in the group deletes instantly, and anyone can restore it from Activity.
groups.deletion_fixed: Chosen now and cannot be changed later.
groups.swipe_hint: Swipe a group left to archive it.
groups.archived_hint: Archived groups don't count toward balances or show up in Activity.

group_detail.delete_body: “{{name}}” will be deleted for every member. The expenses stop being visible. This can't be undone.
group_detail.leave_body: You'll stop seeing this group. The expenses you added stay there for the others, so pending balances aren't lost.
group_detail.invite_message: I'm inviting you to “{{group}}” on SplitP2P. Open this link to join: {{link}}
group_detail.add_without_app: Add someone who doesn't use the app
group_detail.without_app_warning: They'll be part of the splits and you can track what they owe, but they will NOT see the group or receive anything — they don't have the app. To let them see it, add them from your contacts.
group_detail.leave_needs_settle: You have open balances in this group ({{currencies}}). Settle them first: if you left now, the numbers would stop adding up for everyone else.
group_detail.leave_last_member: You're the only one left and there's an open balance. There's nobody to hand it to, so you can't leave without settling it.

expense.delete_body_creator: You can request it and give everyone 72 h to object, or delete it right now.
expense.delete_body_member: Everyone gets 72 h to object. If nobody does, it deletes itself.
expense.delete_pending_body: {{name}} asked to delete this expense. If nobody objects, it goes in {{time}}.
expense.percent_same_hint: for each person · the last one gets the remainder
expense.delete_objected_body: The expense won't be deleted. To try again someone has to request it anew.
expense.delete_body_open: It will be deleted now. Anyone in the group can restore it from Activity.
expense.delete_restored_body: The deletion was undone. To try again someone has to request it anew.
expense.free_over: You've used up today's free ones. For now you can keep adding; later this will need an ad or Pro.

settle.title: Register payment
settle.all_settled: This group is all settled up
settle.split_note: Not enough for everyone: split evenly

delete.request_body: Others have 72 h to object. If no one objects, the expense is deleted automatically.
delete.force_body: Only the creator ({{creatorNote}}) can delete without waiting. Logged in activity.
delete.countdown_suffix: If no one objects before {{date}}, it deletes itself.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty_body: Here you will see your groups’ expenses and payments in chronological order.
activity.search_placeholder: Search by description, person or group

settings.title: Settings
settings.daily_reset_note: The 5th expense requires an ad or Pro. Resets daily at 00:00.

upgrade.title:

upgrade.subtitle: 7 days free · cancel anytime from the App Store.

sync.perm_required_body: We need camera access to scan the QR.
sync.success_body: The other device’s data was imported correctly.
sync.invalid_body: This QR code is not a SplitP2P sync.
sync.how_body: One device shows its QR with its data and the other scans it. Then you do it the other way around to sync in both directions.
sync.show_my_qr_sub: The other device scans this code
sync.scan_qr_sub: Point the camera at the other device’s QR
sync.both_steps_note: To sync both ways, do both steps: show and scan.
sync.show_hint: Show this code to the other device so it can scan it
sync.qr_includes: The QR includes all your groups, expenses and payments
sync.scan_other_hint: Point at the other device’s QR
sync.pair_intro: Pair two devices by QR to sync without a server. The connection is direct and encrypted (WebRTC).
sync.pair_role_offer_sub: Show my QR and scan the reply
sync.pair_role_answer_sub: Scan their QR and show my reply
sync.pair_show_offer_hint: Have the other device scan this code. Then tap “Scan reply”.
sync.pair_show_answer_hint: Have the first device scan this code to finish.
sync.pair_scan_offer_hint: Point at the other device’s QR
sync.pair_connection_failed: Could not connect. Move the devices closer or retry.
sync.pair_copy_hint: …or copy this code and paste it on the other device (no camera).
sync.peer_outdated: The other device is running an older version. Expenses paid by several people will look different there until it updates.
sync.failure_too_large: The group built up more data than fits in one send. Your expenses are saved on this phone, but the others aren't receiving them.
sync.failure_no_key: This device is missing the group's key. Ask someone in the group to share access with you again.

ocr.scan_subtitle: Good light · everything inside the frame
ocr.ocr_badge: OCR detected {{count}} fields. Review before saving.

backup.import_confirm_body: This will replace your current data with the file’s (restore). Continue?
backup.error_invalid_json: The file is not a valid backup.

personal.include_owed_sub: Money pending from your groups adds to the budget
personal.locked_from_group: Comes from a group expense: edit it there
personal.debts_note: Doesn't affect spending until it's settled

friends.empty_body: Add people to create groups and split expenses with them.
friends.new_contact_hint: Enter the name. When you sync via QR, the account links automatically.
friends.remove_body: Remove {{name}}? If they have expenses in active groups, the history is kept.
friends.qr_note: Contacts are added by scanning a QR code: identity travels between devices, there's no user server.
